lede: Pali And Lan Na accounts for 5,227 catalogued manuscripts, 638 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phrae (28% of the corpus for this language), ahead of Lampang and Nan. Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (83%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (13%). Dated witnesses run 1505–2024 CE (3101 of 5,227 carry a date).
